name: boxel-cli
description: Skills for working with Boxel realms via @cardstack/boxel-cli. Requires @cardstack/boxel-cli >= 0.0.1 installed on PATH (npm install -g @cardstack/boxel-cli).

interface.shortDescription: Author and sync Boxel cards, realms, and workspaces
interface.longDescription: Sync Boxel cards, fields, and templates between local disk and a Boxel realm, search across realms, and diagnose realm indexing. Install the boxel-skills plugin alongside it for card authoring, theming, and catalog listings.
defaultPrompt: Search my Boxel realms for cards that match what I describe
Pull my Boxel workspace down so I can edit it locally
